content.short: GeckoTerminal is a CoinGecko platform for tracking DEX prices, pools, liquidity, and charts across many networks.
content.description: GeckoTerminal, built by the team behind CoinGecko, tracks market activity on decentralized exchanges across many blockchains. The platform focuses on token and pool data, interactive charts, trending markets, and onchain analytics that help traders monitor liquidity, volume, transactions, and price movement in real time. It also offers a public API for accessing the same market data programmatically. In the TON ecosystem, GeckoTerminal is mainly used as a research and monitoring tool for pools and tokens rather than a trading venue itself.
